source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.
source.original_treatment_name: Vitis cinerea (Engelm.) Millardet var. helleri (L.H. Bailey) M.O. Moore; synonym V. berlandieri Planch.

historical_var_helleri_only.habit: Moderately to strongly climbing grape vine
historical_var_helleri_only.leaves: Usually under 10 cm, hairy when young but becoming glossy and near-glabrous except woolliness on veins below
historical_var_helleri_only.fruit: Berries moderately to heavily glaucous (contrasted with var. cinerea)
historical_var_helleri_only.habitat: Southern West Cross Timbers and Lampasas Cut Plain to Edwards Plateau

source_scope_note: Historical varieties and synonyms preserved by original names; measurements never automatically transferred to different modern taxon concepts.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: The original flora treats Berlandier grape as V. cinerea var. helleri and brackets V. berlandieri as synonym; modern project accepts V. berlandieri at species rank
Very important not to duplicate current V. cinerea canonical record nor apply var. cinerea hairiness to berlandieri
preservation: Additive source record; existing gallery, pictures, credits and species files unchanged
